## Summary

Describe the change, its intended audience, and the affected project or tool.

## Verification

- [ ] Relevant tests pass; commands and results are included.
- [ ] Accessibility, privacy, and recovery states were checked as applicable.
- [ ] Links and documentation were verified.
- [ ] Any untested environments or evidence gaps are identified.

## Risks

Document compatibility concerns, dependencies, data limitations, rollback needs, and any content not yet ready for publication.
